60 ml (1/4 cup) pan drippings from roast turkey or beef (or extra butter)
480 ml (2 cups) chicken or beef broth
steps: Cover the potatoes with cold salted water, bring to a boil and simmer 15 to 20 minutes until a knife slides in easily; drain well and return to the pot for 1 minute to steam dry.
Mash with 6 tbsp butter and the warm milk until smooth and fluffy, then season with salt and pepper.
For the gravy, heat the drippings with the remaining butter in a saucepan over medium heat and whisk in the flour; cook 2 to 3 minutes until light brown.
Whisk in the broth slowly and simmer 5 minutes until smooth and thick enough to coat a spoon, seasoning to taste.
Pile the potatoes into a bowl, make a well in the top and pour the hot gravy over.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 680 g (1 1/2 lb) fresh green beans, trimmed and halved (or 2 bags frozen, thawed)
150 g (2 2/3 cups) crispy fried onions, divided
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F); blanch the green beans in boiling salted water for 5 minutes, then plunge into ice water and drain.
Melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat and cook the mushrooms 6 minutes until browned; add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Stir in the flour, then whisk in the broth and milk and simmer 4 minutes until thick; add the soy sauce, salt and pepper (this replaces canned cream-of-mushroom soup).
Fold in the beans and half the fried onions and spread in a 2 l (2 quart) baking dish.
Bake 20 minutes until bubbling, top with the remaining onions and bake 5 minutes more until golden.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 1 tbsp chopped chives or a pinch of paprika, optional
steps: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.
Add the corn and boil 4 to 6 minutes until the kernels are bright yellow and tender when pierced; or grill over medium-high heat 10 minutes, turning, until lightly charred.
Lift out with tongs and drain.
Roll each ear in butter, sprinkle with salt, pepper and chives, and serve hot.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 4 large russet potatoes (about 300 g / 10 oz each)
4 slices bacon, cooked crisp and crumbled
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F); scrub the potatoes, prick them several times with a fork, rub with oil and coarse salt.
Bake directly on the oven rack for 55 to 65 minutes until the skins are crisp and a skewer slides easily into the center.
Slit each potato lengthwise and squeeze the ends to fluff the insides.
Add a tablespoon of butter to each, then the cheddar, and return to the oven 3 to 4 minutes to melt.
Top with sour cream, crumbled bacon and scallions and serve hot.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 45 g (3 tbsp) butter, melted, plus more for the pan
maple syrup and butter, to serve
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a large bowl.
Whisk the buttermilk, eggs and melted butter in another bowl, pour into the dry ingredients and stir just until combined; small lumps are fine.
Heat a griddle or skillet over medium heat and brush lightly with butter.
Pour 60 ml (1/4 cup) batter per pancake and cook 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles form and the edges look set, then flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes until golden.
Serve in stacks with butter and warm maple syrup.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: maple syrup, berries and whipped cream, to serve
steps: Preheat a waffle iron and whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
Whisk the egg yolks with the milk, melted butter and vanilla, then stir into the dry ingredients until just combined.
Beat the egg whites to soft peaks and fold gently into the batter for extra crispness.
Grease the iron, pour in enough batter to cover about two-thirds of the grid and cook 4 to 5 minutes until golden and crisp and the steam slows.
Serve immediately with maple syrup, berries and whipped cream.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 8 thick slices day-old brioche, challah or Texas toast
2 tbsp (30 g) butter, for the pan
maple syrup and powdered sugar, to serve
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, sugar, vanilla, cinnamon and salt in a shallow dish.
Heat a large skillet or griddle over medium heat and melt a little butter.
Dip each slice of bread in the custard for about 10 seconds per side so it soaks through without falling apart.
Cook 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden brown and set in the center, adding butter as needed.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve with maple syrup and fresh berries.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: pinch of salt and black pepper
steps: Lay the bacon in a cold skillet and cook over medium heat 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until crisp; drain on paper towels.
Pour off most of the fat, leaving about 1 tsp, and add the butter over medium-low heat.
Crack the eggs into the pan and cook 3 to 4 minutes until the whites are fully set (sunny-side up), or flip and cook 1 minute more for over-easy; for scrambled, stir gently until just set.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with the bacon and buttered toast.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 4 tbsp vegetable oil or clarified butter
steps: Grate the potatoes on the large holes of a box grater and rinse in cold water to remove starch.
Wrap in a clean kitchen towel and wring out as much liquid as possible, then toss with the onion, salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering and spread the potatoes in a thin, even layer, pressing down.
Cook undisturbed 6 to 8 minutes until the bottom is deep golden and crisp.
Flip in sections and cook 5 minutes more until crisp on both sides, then serve hot with eggs.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 450 g (1 lb) cooked corned beef, diced
680 g (1 1/2 lb) potatoes, peeled and diced 1 cm (1/2 inch)
steps: Boil the diced potatoes in salted water 5 to 6 minutes until just tender, then drain well.
Heat the butter and oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium heat and cook the onion and pepper 5 minutes until soft.
Add the potatoes and corned beef, press into an even layer, and cook undisturbed 8 minutes until a brown crust forms.
Flip in sections and cook another 8 minutes until crisp all over and heated through; season with pepper.
Make 4 wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 4 to 5 minutes until the whites are set, then scatter with parsley and serve.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 150 g (3/4 cup) sugar, plus 2 tbsp for the tops
225 g (1 1/2 cups) fresh or frozen blueberries
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F) and line a 12-cup muffin pan with paper liners.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
Whisk the melted butter, eggs, milk and vanilla, pour into the dry mix and stir just until no dry flour remains.
Fold in the blueberries gently, divide among the cups and sprinkle the tops with sugar.
Bake 20 to 22 minutes until domed, golden and a toothpick in the center comes out clean; cool 5 minutes in the pan.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 85 g (6 tbsp) butter, softened, for the dough
150 g (3/4 cup) packed brown sugar and 2 tbsp cinnamon mixed with 85 g (6 tbsp) soft butter, for the filling
115 g (4 oz) cream cheese, 60 g (4 tbsp) butter, 120 g (1 cup) powdered sugar and 1 tsp vanilla, for the icing
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt, add the warm milk, egg and butter, and knead 8 to 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover and let rise in a warm place 1 to 1 1/2 hours until doubled.
Roll the dough into a 40 x 30 cm (16 x 12 inch) rectangle, spread with the cinnamon-sugar butter, roll up tightly from the long side and cut into 12 slices.
Arrange in a buttered 23 x 33 cm (9 x 13 inch) pan, cover and let rise 45 minutes until puffy; heat the oven to 175°C (350°F).
Bake 22 to 25 minutes until golden and the centers are cooked.
Beat the cream cheese, butter, powdered sugar and vanilla until smooth and spread over the warm rolls.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 3 very ripe bananas, mashed (about 340 g / 1 1/2 cups)
steps: Heat the oven to 175°C (350°F) and butter a 23 x 13 cm (9 x 5 inch) loaf pan.
Mix the mashed bananas with the melted butter, then stir in the sugar, egg and vanilla.
Sprinkle over the baking soda, salt and cinnamon, then fold in the flour and walnuts just until combined.
Pour into the pan and bake 55 to 65 minutes until a skewer in the center comes out clean.
Cool 10 minutes in the pan, then turn out onto a rack and cool before slicing.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 115 g (4 oz) cooked crab meat or imitation crab (surimi), finely chopped
1 l (4 cups) vegetable oil, for frying
sweet-and-sour or sweet chili sauce, to serve
steps: Beat the cream cheese with the crab, scallions, soy sauce, Worcestershire, garlic powder and sugar until well mixed.
Place 1 heaped tsp of filling in the center of each wrapper, wet the edges with water, and pinch the four corners up to the center, sealing the seams to make a star-shaped purse.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot to 175°C (350°F).
Fry 5 or 6 at a time for 2 to 3 minutes until golden and crisp, turning once, and drain on a rack.
Serve hot with sweet-and-sour sauce, as at American Chinese takeout restaurants.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 1 can (225 g / 8 oz) refrigerated crescent roll dough, or puff pastry
1 large egg, beaten with 1 tbsp water
1 tsp everything-bagel seasoning or sesame seeds, optional
4 tbsp yellow or honey mustard, to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F) and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Unroll the dough, press the seams together and cut into 24 thin triangles or strips.
Roll each sausage up in a piece of dough, seam-side down, and arrange on the sheet.
Brush with egg wash and sprinkle with seasoning.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes until puffed and golden and the sausages are hot through, then serve warm with mustard and ketchup.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 12 sticks (340 g / 12 oz) low-moisture mozzarella string cheese, halved
1 l (4 cups) vegetable oil, for frying
240 ml (1 cup) marinara sauce, warmed, to serve
steps: Mix the breadcrumbs, panko and garlic powder; dredge each cheese stick in flour, dip in egg, then coat in crumbs.
Dip again in egg and crumbs for a double coat that keeps the cheese from leaking.
Freeze the coated sticks on a tray for at least 1 hour until firm.
Heat the oil to 180°C (350°F) and fry in small batches straight from the freezer for 1 to 2 minutes until golden.
Drain briefly and serve immediately with warm marinara.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 30 g (1/2 cup) panko tossed with 1 tbsp melted butter
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F); halve the jalapeños lengthwise and scrape out the seeds and ribs, wearing gloves if your skin is sensitive.
Mix the cream cheese, cheddar, scallions, garlic powder and smoked paprika until smooth.
Fill each jalapeño half generously and set on a lined baking sheet.
Sprinkle with the buttery panko and bake 15 to 20 minutes until the peppers are tender and the tops golden and bubbling.
Cool 5 minutes before serving, as the filling is very hot.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 6 slices bacon, cooked crisp and crumbled
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F), prick the potatoes and bake 50 to 60 minutes until tender, then cool 10 minutes.
Halve lengthwise and scoop out the flesh, leaving a 6 mm (1/4 inch) shell; save the flesh for mashed potatoes.
Brush the skins inside and out with oil, sprinkle with salt, and bake cut-side up 10 minutes, then flip and bake 5 minutes more until crisp.
Turn cut-side up, fill with cheddar and bacon, and bake 3 to 5 minutes until the cheese melts.
Top with sour cream and scallions and serve hot.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 285 g (10 oz) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
1 can (400 g / 14 oz) artichoke hearts in water, drained and chopped
tortilla chips or toasted baguette slices, to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F).
Beat the cream cheese, sour cream, mayonnaise and garlic until smooth.
Stir in the spinach, artichokes, Parmesan and half the mozzarella, and season with salt and pepper.
Spread in a small baking dish, top with the rest of the mozzarella and bake 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling and golden.
Serve hot with tortilla chips or toasted bread.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 680 g (1 1/2 lb) large shrimp (16–20 per lb), shell-on
1 lemon, halved, plus wedges to serve
160 ml (2/3 cup) ketchup or chili sauce
1 tsp lemon juice and a few dashes hot sauce
steps: Bring 2 l (8 cups) water to a boil with the lemon halves, bay leaf and salt.
Add the shrimp, turn off the heat and leave 3 to 4 minutes until pink, opaque and curled into a C shape.
Plunge into ice water to stop the cooking, then peel, leaving the tails on, and devein.
Stir the ketchup, horseradish, Worcestershire, lemon juice and hot sauce together for the cocktail sauce.
Chill the shrimp at least 30 minutes and serve hung over the rim of a glass of cocktail sauce with lemon wedges.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 1 l (4 cups) vegetable oil, for frying
60 g (1/2 cup) powdered sugar, for dusting
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt, then whisk in the eggs, milk and vanilla to a smooth, pourable batter.
Heat 2.5 cm (1 inch) of oil in a wide heavy skillet to 190°C (375°F).
Pour 120 ml (1/2 cup) batter through a funnel (or a squeeze bottle), holding your finger over the spout, swirling it into the oil in a lacy spiral about 15 cm (6 inches) wide.
Fry 1 to 2 minutes per side until golden, flipping carefully with tongs, then drain on paper towels.
Dust heavily with powdered sugar and serve warm, county-fair style.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 2 pie crusts for a 23 cm (9 inch) double-crust pie, made with butter (no egg)
1.2 kg (about 7) tart apples such as Granny Smith, peeled and sliced 6 mm (1/4 inch)
100 g (1/2 cup) sugar, plus 1 tbsp for the top
2 tbsp (30 g) butter, cut in bits
2 tbsp milk or cream, for brushing
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F) and line a 23 cm (9 inch) pie dish with one crust.
Toss the apples with the sugars, cornstarch, cinnamon, nutmeg and lemon juice and pile into the crust, dotting with butter.
Cover with the top crust or a lattice, trim and crimp the edges, cut steam vents, brush with milk and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake 20 minutes, then lower to 190°C (375°F) and bake 40 to 45 minutes more until the crust is deep golden and the juices bubble thickly through the vents.
Cool at least 2 hours so the filling sets, and serve with vanilla ice cream (à la mode) or a slice of cheddar.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 1 can (425 g / 15 oz) pure pumpkin purée
1 can (355 ml / 12 fl oz) evaporated milk
1/4 tsp ground nutmeg and a pinch of cloves
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F) and set the crust in its dish on a baking sheet.
Whisk the pumpkin, sugar, spices and salt, then whisk in the eggs and evaporated milk until smooth.
Pour the filling into the crust.
Bake 15 minutes, then lower to 175°C (350°F) and bake 40 to 45 minutes until the edges are set and the center jiggles only slightly.
Cool completely on a rack (at least 2 hours) and serve with whipped cream for Thanksgiving.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 200 g (1 cup) sugar for the filling, plus 100 g (1/2 cup) for the meringue
steps: Heat the oven to 175°C (350°F); whisk 200 g sugar with the cornstarch and water in a saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring, until thick and boiling.
Whisk a little of the hot mixture into the yolks, return it to the pan and cook 2 minutes more, then stir in the lemon juice, zest and butter.
Pour the hot filling into the baked crust.
Beat the egg whites with the cream of tartar to soft peaks, then add the remaining sugar gradually and beat to stiff, glossy peaks.
Spread the meringue over the hot filling right to the crust edge to seal, swirl into peaks, and bake 12 to 15 minutes until golden.
Cool to room temperature, then chill at least 3 hours before slicing.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

steps: Heat the oven to 175°C (350°F) and butter a 23 x 33 cm (9 x 13 inch) baking dish.
Toss the apples with the sugar, half the cinnamon, lemon juice and cornstarch and spread in the dish.
Mix the flour, oats, brown sugar, salt and remaining cinnamon, then rub in the cold butter with your fingertips until clumpy.
Scatter the topping evenly over the apples.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes until the topping is golden and the fruit bubbles at the edges, and serve warm with vanilla ice cream.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 450 g (1 lb) fresh strawberries, hulled and sliced
50 g (1/4 cup) sugar for the berries, plus 2 tbsp for the biscuits
240 ml (1 cup) heavy cream, whipped with 1 tbsp sugar and 1/2 tsp vanilla
steps: Toss the strawberries with 50 g sugar and leave 30 minutes until juicy.
Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F); mix the flour, 2 tbsp sugar, baking powder and salt and rub in the butter until it looks like coarse crumbs.
Whisk the egg with the cream, stir into the flour just until a shaggy dough forms, pat 2 cm (3/4 inch) thick and cut 6 rounds.
Bake 15 to 18 minutes until risen and golden, then cool slightly.
Split the shortcakes, spoon on the berries and their juice, top with whipped cream and replace the tops.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F) and line baking sheets with parchment.
Cream the butter and both sugars until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Mix in the flour, baking soda and salt on low just until combined, then stir in the chocolate chips.
Scoop 2 tbsp mounds 5 cm (2 inches) apart onto the sheets.
Bake 9 to 11 minutes until the edges are golden but the centers look slightly underdone, then cool 5 minutes on the sheet before moving to a rack.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 100 g (1/2 cup) sugar, plus extra for rolling
steps: Heat the oven to 175°C (350°F) and line baking sheets.
Beat the butter, peanut butter and both sugars until fluffy, then beat in the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking soda and salt until a soft dough forms.
Roll into 3 cm (1 1/4 inch) balls, roll in sugar and press each flat with a fork twice to make the classic crisscross.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes until lightly golden at the edges, and cool on the sheet 5 minutes.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 2 large eggs and 1 tsp vanilla extract
steps: Heat the oven to 175°C (350°F) and line baking sheets.
Cream the butter and sugars until light, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Mix in the flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt, then stir in the oats and raisins.
Drop rounded tablespoons 5 cm (2 inches) apart on the sheets.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes until golden at the edges but still soft in the middle, then cool on a rack.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 3 tbsp sugar mixed with 1 tbsp ground cinnamon, for rolling
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F) and line baking sheets.
Cream the butter and sugar until fluffy, then beat in the eggs.
Stir in the flour, cream of tartar, baking soda and salt (the cream of tartar gives the classic tang and chew).
Roll into 3 cm (1 1/4 inch) balls and roll each in cinnamon sugar.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes until set at the edges and crinkled on top but still soft in the center, then cool on a rack.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 170 g (6 oz) semi-sweet or dark chocolate, chopped
90 g (1/2 cup) chocolate chips or chopped walnuts, optional
steps: Heat the oven to 175°C (350°F) and line a 23 x 23 cm (9 x 9 inch) pan with parchment.
Melt the butter and chocolate together over low heat or in short microwave bursts, stirring until smooth.
Whisk in the sugar, then the eggs one at a time and the vanilla, until glossy.
Fold in the flour, cocoa and salt, then the chips or nuts, and spread in the pan.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes until a toothpick comes out with moist crumbs; cool completely before cutting into squares.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 2 tsp baking soda and 1 tsp baking powder
240 ml (1 cup) hot coffee or hot water
340 g (12 oz) dark chocolate melted into 360 ml (1 1/2 cups) hot cream, cooled, for the frosting
steps: Heat the oven to 175°C (350°F) and grease and line two 23 cm (9 inch) round pans.
Whisk the flour, cocoa, sugar, baking soda, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.
Beat in the eggs, buttermilk, oil and vanilla, then whisk in the hot coffee to a thin batter.
Divide between the pans and bake 30 to 35 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean; cool 10 minutes, then turn out onto racks.
Chill the chocolate ganache until spreadable, then beat briefly and use it to fill and frost the cooled layers.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp baking soda and 1/2 tsp salt
2 tsp ground cinnamon and 1/2 tsp nutmeg
120 g (1 cup) chopped walnuts or pecans
1 can (225 g / 8 oz) crushed pineapple, drained
225 g (8 oz) cream cheese, 115 g (1/2 cup) butter, 360 g (3 cups) powdered sugar and 1 tsp vanilla, for the frosting
steps: Heat the oven to 175°C (350°F) and grease and line two 23 cm (9 inch) round pans.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, soda, salt and spices.
Beat the eggs and sugar until pale, then beat in the oil; fold in the dry ingredients, then the carrots, nuts and pineapple.
Divide between the pans and bake 35 to 40 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean, then cool completely.
Beat the cream cheese and butter until smooth, add the powdered sugar and vanilla, and use to fill and frost the cake.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 12 large egg whites (about 360 ml / 1 1/2 cups), at room temperature
fresh berries and whipped cream, to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 175°C (350°F); have ready an ungreased 25 cm (10 inch) tube pan.
Sift the flour with half the sugar twice.
Beat the egg whites with the cream of tartar and salt to soft peaks, then add the remaining sugar gradually and beat to firm, glossy peaks; beat in the extracts.
Sift the flour mixture over the whites in three additions, folding gently each time, then spoon into the pan and run a knife through to remove air pockets.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes until golden and springy, then immediately invert the pan over a bottle and cool completely upside down before loosening and serving with berries.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 60 g (4 tbsp) butter, melted, for the topping
7 canned pineapple rings in juice, drained (juice reserved)
1 1/2 tsp baking powder and 1/4 tsp salt
2 large eggs and 1 tsp vanilla extract
steps: Heat the oven to 175°C (350°F); pour the melted butter into a 23 cm (9 inch) round pan or cast-iron skillet and sprinkle evenly with the brown sugar.
Arrange the pineapple rings over the sugar with a cherry in the center of each.
Cream the butter and sugar until fluffy, beat in the eggs and vanilla, then add the flour mix alternately with the pineapple juice.
Spread the batter carefully over the fruit and bake 40 to 45 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool 10 minutes, run a knife around the edge and invert onto a plate so the caramelized fruit is on top.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 180 g (6 cups) crisp rice cereal (Rice Krispies)
steps: Butter a 23 x 33 cm (9 x 13 inch) pan; regular marshmallows contain gelatin, so use gelatin-free ones to keep this vegetarian.
Melt the butter in a large pot over low heat, add the marshmallows and stir until completely melted and smooth.
Remove from the heat, stir in the vanilla and salt, then fold in the cereal until evenly coated.
Press gently into the pan with a buttered spatula, without packing too hard, and cool 30 minutes before cutting into squares.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 4 whole graham crackers, broken into 8 squares
1 bar (43 g / 1.5 oz) milk chocolate, broken into 4 pieces
steps: Lay a piece of chocolate on 4 of the graham cracker squares.
Thread each marshmallow on a skewer and toast over a campfire or grill, about 15 cm (6 inches) above glowing embers, turning slowly for 1 to 2 minutes until puffed and golden brown.
Place the hot marshmallow on the chocolate, top with a second graham square and press to slide it off the skewer.
Wait 30 seconds so the chocolate softens, then eat right away.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 6 crisp tart apples such as Granny Smith, washed and very dry
1 tsp vanilla extract and a pinch of salt
steps: Push a stick firmly into the stem end of each apple and line a tray with buttered parchment.
Combine the sugar, cream, butter and corn syrup in a heavy saucepan and bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring.
Cook without stirring until a candy thermometer reads 118°C (245°F), about 8 to 10 minutes, then stir in the vanilla and salt and cool 5 minutes.
Dip each apple, twisting to coat, let the excess drip off, roll the base in peanuts and set on the tray.
Leave 30 minutes until the caramel sets before serving.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 1 ripe banana, peeled and halved lengthwise
1 scoop each vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream (about 200 g / 1 1/2 cups total)
2 tbsp chocolate syrup or hot fudge
1 tbsp chopped peanuts and 3 maraschino cherries
steps: Lay the banana halves along the sides of a long, shallow dish.
Place the three scoops of ice cream in a row between them.
Spoon pineapple topping over the vanilla, strawberry over the strawberry and chocolate over the chocolate scoop.
Pipe whipped cream on each scoop, sprinkle with peanuts, crown with cherries and serve immediately.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 8 scoops vanilla ice cream (about 500 g / 1 pint)
whipped cream, chopped peanuts and 4 maraschino cherries
steps: Heat the cream, corn syrup and butter in a small saucepan over medium heat until it simmers.
Remove from the heat, add the chocolate and stir until completely smooth and glossy, then stir in the vanilla.
Put 2 scoops of ice cream in each sundae glass.
Pour the warm hot fudge over, top with whipped cream and peanuts, add a cherry and serve at once.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 4 large scoops vanilla ice cream (about 500 g / 1 pint)
2 tbsp chocolate syrup or 75 g (1/2 cup) strawberries, optional for flavor
whipped cream and maraschino cherries, to serve
steps: Chill two tall glasses in the freezer for 10 minutes.
Blend the ice cream, milk, vanilla and any flavoring for 20 to 30 seconds, just until smooth and thick enough to hold a straw.
Pour into the cold glasses, top with whipped cream and a cherry, and serve with straws and long spoons.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 4 scoops vanilla ice cream (about 250 g / 1/2 pint)
2 bottles (355 ml / 12 fl oz each) cold root beer
steps: Chill two tall glasses or mugs in the freezer for 10 minutes.
Put 2 scoops of ice cream in each glass.
Pour the root beer slowly down the side of the glass so the foam rises without overflowing, topping up as it settles.
Add whipped cream if you like and serve at once with a straw and a long spoon.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook

ingredients: 240 ml (1 cup) fresh lemon juice (about 6 lemons)
ice cubes and mint sprigs, to serve
steps: Heat the sugar with 240 ml (1 cup) of the water in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring until dissolved, to make a simple syrup; cool.
Stir the lemon juice, syrup and remaining cold water together in a large pitcher and taste, adding more water or syrup to balance.
Add the lemon slices and chill at least 1 hour.
Serve over plenty of ice with a sprig of mint.
recipe.source: AI-written (Claude) — not yet reviewed by a cook
